title: KRC Commerzone Raidurg, host of the Qualcomm Hyderabad campus

tenant.name: Qualcomm India (GCC)
tenant.occupies: The whole building, fully leased to Qualcomm on a lease of about 12 years (Mindspace REIT, 2025). Earlier reports mention 17 floors and about 1.6 million sq ft.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap way 1133460476 "Qualcomm Commerzone": 22 levels, height 100 m (ODbL)

KRC Commerzone, Hyderabad: 20 storey superstructure, two conjoined towers on an L-shaped footprint, central cores with high and low zone lift banks, 9 acre site, 4.5 acre podium, 2.63 million sq ft leasable
K Raheja Corp: Mindspace REIT to acquire 1.8 million sq ft Commerzone Raidurg (Sustain Properties), fully leased to a Fortune 500 GCC, completed 2023
Qualcomm signs Telangana's largest SEZ lease: 17 floors at the Sustain Properties SEZ, Raidurg

status.footprint: Measured: OpenStreetMap outline (about 12,100 m2) as three rectangles; it may include podium edges
status.storeys: Estimated: ground floor and 19 office floors at 4.5 m, 3 basement levels. OpenStreetMap gives 22 levels and 100 m; the architect describes a 20 storey superstructure
status.floorPlate: Estimated: no public floor plan was found. The outline on every floor gives about 2.6 million sq ft above ground, close to the stated leasable area
status.cores: Estimated: two central service cores, one per tower

unknowns: green rating (none found in public sources)
